commit.message:
fix(docker): bump chainguard/git base to drop emSign ECC Root CA - G3 (#465)

The pinned digest's ca-certificates still trusts emSign ECC Root CA - G3,
which Mozilla removed after eMudhra's G3 intermediates were found to have
trivially recoverable private keys (Mozilla bug 2083449). The current
chainguard/git image no longer ships it.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
chore(ci): pin workflow actions via GitHub Actions lockfile (#462)

Move action pinning from inline commit SHAs to the new
`.github/workflows/actions.lock` generated by `gh actions-lock`.
Workflows now reference version tags; the lockfile records the
resolved commit SHA, owner_id and repo_id for each dependency
(including transitive ones).

All resolved SHAs are unchanged from the previous inline pins.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
perf(scanner): hoist parser regexps to package level (#447)

Compile the five parser path patterns once at package init instead of
recompiling them in each parser constructor on every repo scan.

BenchmarkNewMemParsers: 9673ns→57ns (169x), 30424B→120B, 255→6 allocs.

Signed-off-by: Matías Insaurralde <matias@insaurral.de>
